# routeros_mpls_mangle (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chain` (String) Chain the rule belongs to. `forward` processes the transit labeled packets, `output` processes the labeled packets originated by this router.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `exp` (Number) Matches the EXP (traffic class) bits of the topmost label of the packet.
- `set_exp` (Number) New EXP (traffic class) bit value written into the topmost label of the matched packet.
- `set_mark` (String) Packet mark assigned to the matched packet so that it can be picked up by the queue tree. The value `no-mark` removes the mark.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
